capabilities.heading: When custom software is worth it

approach.heading: A plan only matters once your team can use it.
approach.sub: Choose a launch point and see when the work starts creating value.
approach.loop: Then measure, adjust, and improve it.

stages.label: Locate the bottleneck
stages.detail: Who does the work, where it stalls, what it costs.

stages.label: Choose the smallest useful fix
stages.detail: Change the process, connect tools, or write code.

stages.label: Run an early version
stages.detail: Your team tests it with real data.

stops.consequence: I build only the core workflow, then your team uses it first.
Your team tests each working part as I finish it.
I finish the agreed workflow before putting it into operation.
The project stays in documents and changes no real work.

engagements.heading: Start small. Put it to work.
engagements.sub: Depending on the problem, I can stop at a clear plan, test one workflow, or take the full system into stable operation.

answers.heading: What to settle before the work starts
answers.sub: Pricing, ownership, and choosing what to change.

closing.heading: Start with the work that is stuck, not an app idea.
closing.reassure: Tell me which step is slow, error-prone, or consuming too much staff time. I will map it with you, then send a plan and quote. If you do not need custom code, I will say so.
